audit_items.scope_notes: The ECDSA signature verification logic for secp256r1 (P256) is implemented in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. The codebase only contains a thin precompile wrapper (Secp256r1Precompile.cs:30) that delegates to Secp256r1.VerifySignature(). The invariant about computing R' = u1*G + u2*Q cannot be audited in this codebase.

The modular comparison r' == r (mod n) is part of the ECDSA verification algorithm implemented in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. This codebase only contains the precompile wrapper that delegates to the external library.

The modular inverse computation s^(-1) mod n is part of the ECDSA verification algorithm implemented in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. This invariant cannot be audited in this codebase.
Scalar multiplications and point addition for secp256r1 group operations are implemented in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. This invariant cannot be audited in this codebase.

Field element bounds checking for public key coordinates against field modulus p is implemented in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. This invariant cannot be audited in this codebase.

Input decoding of five 32-byte BigEndian fields is implemented in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. The precompile wrapper passes inputData directly to Secp256r1.VerifySignature() without parsing.
The gas cost of 6900 is defined in the precompile wrapper at Secp256r1Precompile.cs:22. However, whether this is sufficient for worst-case execution depends on the external library implementation.
Constant-time implementation of modular inverse and elliptic curve operations is in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. Side-channel resistance cannot be audited in this codebase.

Correctness of P256VERIFY returning 0x01 for valid signatures is implemented in external NuGet package Nethermind.Crypto.SecP256r1. The precompile wrapper returns ValidResult (0x01 padded to 32 bytes) when VerifySignature returns true.
